name: @pipeworx/mcp-htmltext

tools.name: html_to_text
tools.description: Convert HTML to readable plain text (keyless, offline): drops scripts/styles/comments, converts block elements to newlines, decodes entities, and collapses whitespace. Ideal for cleaning scraped HTML.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Extract all hyperlinks from HTML as {href, text} pairs (keyless, offline).

tools.name: extract_metadata
tools.description: Pull page metadata from HTML (keyless, offline): <title>, meta description/keywords, and Open Graph (og:*) tags.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-htmltext forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the htmltext pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
